author: Ari Koslow
title: Manny Machado collects three hits Sunday
desc: Manny Machado went 3-for-4 in the Padres 5-4 win over the Blue Jays on Sunday.
impact: Machado singled and later scored to put San Diego on the board in the second inning. He later tied the game with an RBI single in the eighth inning. He takes a disastrous .203 batting average into the All-Star break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Mason Miller earns save Sunday
desc: Mason Miller worked a clean inning for the save on Sunday against the Blue Jays.
impact: Miller needed just eight pitches with one strikeout for his 25th save on the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: German Marquez pitches four innings Sunday
desc: German Marquez allowed three runs on six hits over four innings with four strikeouts and two walks in a no-decision on Sunday against the Blue Jays.
impact: Marquez allowed a pair of home runs to Nathan Lukes and Ernie Clement. He takes a 5.18 ERA into the All-Star break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Tim Tawa hits home run Sunday
desc: Tim Tawa went 1-for-4 with a home run in the Diamondbacks 5-3 win over the Dodgers on Sunday.
impact: Tawa capped off a strong weekend series with a solo home run in the ninth inning to give Arizona an insurance run in its 5-3 win.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Paul Sewald earns save Sunday
desc: Paul Sewald threw a clean inning for a save on Sunday against the Dodgers.
impact: Sewald needed just 12 pitches with one strikeout to earn his 22nd save on the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Mitch Bratt allows three runs Sunday
desc: Mitch Bratt allowed three runs on three hits over three innings with three walks in a no-decision on Sunday against the Dodgers.
impact: Bratt got a spot start after Zac Gallen was scratched. He'll remain off the fantasy radar if he remains in the majors.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Randy Arozarena goes deep Sunday
desc: Randy Arozarena went 1-for-5 with a home run and three RBI in the Mariners 8-2 win over the Rays on Sunday.
impact: Arozarena broke the game open with a three-run blast to extend the lead to 7-0. He goes into the break as an All-Star, hitting .286 with 11 home runs and 45 RBI.

author: Ari Koslow
title: J.P. Crawford drives in three runs Sunday
desc: J.P. Crawford went 3-for-4 with three RBI in the Mariners 8-2 win over the Rays on Sunday.
impact: Crawford capped off a three-run second inning with a two-run double. He later added another RBI double. Despite his big performance on Sunday, he's still hitting just .218 going into the All-Star break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Henry Davis goes deep Sunday
desc: Henry Davis went 2-for-4 with a home run and three RBI in the Pirates 14-5 win over the Brewers on Sunday.
impact: Davis capped off a four-run second inning for Pittsburgh with a two-run long ball. He is slashing .166/.267/.344 with eight home runs and 27 RBI on the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Marcell Ozuna hits home run Sunday
desc: Marcell Ozuna went 2-for-5 with a home run in the Pirates 14-5 win over the Brewers on Sunday.
impact: Ozuna opened the bottom of the fourth inning with a solo home run. It was the start of what went on to be a 10-run frame for Pittsburgh. He is slashing just .205/.288/.305 on the season with eight long balls and 28 RBI.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Paul Skenes earns win Sunday
desc: Paul Skenes allowed two runs on three hits over 5 1/3 innings with seven strikeouts and one walk in a win on Sunday against the Brewers.
impact: Skenes was given plenty run support on the afternoon in the win. He takes a 3.57 ERA across 20 starts into the All-Star break.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Justin Crawford (knee) completes pregame workout Sunday
desc: Justin Crawford went through a pregame workout on Sunday.
impact: Crawford was scratched from Friday's lineup against the Detroit Tigers due to left knee soreness and has not played since. He did complete a pregame workout on Sunday, indicating he could be ready for game action following the All-Star break.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Daniel Susac (back) could return following All-Star break
desc: Daniel Susac is currently on a rehab assignment with Triple-A Sacramento and is on track to return during the San Francisco Giants' series against the Seattle Mariners from July 17-19.
impact: Susac has been sidelined since June 26 due to a lower back strain. When he returns, Eric Haase or Jesus Rodriguez are candidates to be optioned to make room on the roster.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jordan Montgomery (elbow) throws 52 pitches in rehab start Sunday
desc: Jordan Montgomery threw 52 pitches over four innings in a rehab start on Sunday for Triple-A Round Rock.
impact: Montgomery allowed one run on four hits with one strikeout. He is continuing to work his way back from Tommy John surgery.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Dax Fulton recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Miami Marlins recalled Dax Fulton from Triple-A Jacksonville on Sunday.
impact: With William Kempner (elbow) being placed on the injured list, Fulton will take his place in the bullpen. Fulton has made three appearances in the majors, posting a 2.57 ERA and 0.86 WHIP with six strikeouts across seven innings. He provides the Marlins with a multi-inning relief option.
